scenarios.title: Normal central command
scenarios.description: Successful path from commit through effect confirmation

scenarios.title: Duplicate delivery
scenarios.description: Deliver the same command twice and limit the physical effect to one attempt

scenarios.title: Lost ACK
scenarios.description: Crash after the effect but before saving the CRA receipt, then redeliver the same outbox entry

scenarios.title: Crash before central commit
scenarios.description: Atomic rollback of command intent and outbox

scenarios.title: Crash after Dell ACCEPTED
scenarios.description: Agent crash after durable acceptance but before the effect

scenarios.title: Crash after Dell EXECUTION_STARTED
scenarios.description: Classify an agent crash before the effect boundary as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

scenarios.title: stale authority epoch
scenarios.description: Reject an epoch that does not match the Dell high-water mark

scenarios.title: stale command sequence
scenarios.description: Reject a consumed sequence even with a new command ID

scenarios.title: command sequence gap
scenarios.description: Reject sequences beyond high-water + 1

scenarios.title: stale target
scenarios.description: Reject the effect if the target changes at the second observation

scenarios.title: Dell ledger failure
scenarios.description: Fail closed on effects when the ledger is unhealthy

scenarios.title: Delayed heartbeat and recovery
scenarios.description: Return to central authority when a heartbeat arrives within TTL after suspicion

scenarios.title: heartbeat lease expiry
scenarios.description: Transition to local fallback when TTL expires

scenarios.title: local fallback action
scenarios.description: Execute one allowlisted action only under local authority

scenarios.title: reconciliation
scenarios.description: Monotonically advance the epoch via challenge/commit, then wait for a heartbeat

scenarios.title: backup restore fencing
scenarios.description: Make stale pending entries in a restored database terminal and undeliverable

scenarios.title: 2026-08-21 replay
scenarios.description: Replay real-failure fixtures without generating automatic commands from insufficient evidence
